verdict.rationale: Fellow's own Developer API lets users pull notes as GitHub-Flavored Markdown, which round-trips, along with diarized transcripts, recordings and action items through paginated REST endpoints. The Enterprise Super Admin API can retrieve, export and delete data across the whole workspace to back up notes and transcripts. However, exporting requires writing code against an API that is limited to paid plans and must be enabled by an admin. There is no documented self-serve export of all data, and Fellow Markdown adds proprietary extensions. missing for 10: one-click or bulk full-account export, documented export of audio/video media, a self-serve leave/account-deletion path for individual users, export not gated behind paid/Enterprise plans, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: The Developer API opens that data to you: transcripts, structured notes, and more, all available through standard REST calls.
It is GitHub-Flavored Markdown plus Fellow extensions for the things Fellow notes have and plain markdown doesn't

Fellow’s Super Admin API lets designated Enterprise‑plan administrators retrieve, export, and delete data across the entire workspace, making it simple to back up notes and transcripts for legal purposes
These must be explicitly requested using the `include` parameter
The API is available on any Fellow workspace with a paid plan, and can be enabled or disabled for all users from Workspace Settings > Developer > API
